WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER 1.

Heard Sri.Venkatesh Naik, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri.Thejesh P., learned HCGP for respondent No.1 and Sri.Chandrahasa Rai B., learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2.

The petitioner, who is accused No.1, is before this Court seeking following prayer:
"To quash the FIR in Cr.No.62/2024 dated 11.02.2024 registered by the Jnanbharathi Police against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 354, 307 read with Section 34 of the IPC read with Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 based on the complaint lodged NC: 2024:KHC:40486 by 2nd respondent and the proceedings pending before the Hon'ble IX ACMM,
Bengaluru City."
3. During the pendency of the petition, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves by drawing up terms of settlement.

They have filed individual affidavits of petitioner and respondent No.2 in support of the same, which read as follows:
"AFFIDAVIT I, SREEDHARA S/o Channaraju H.B, Aged about 35 years, R/at No.126, 3rd Cross, 4th Main, KPSC Layout, Bangalore - 560 056, do hereby solemnly state on oath as follows 1.
I state that I am the Petitioner in the above case and the 2nd Respondent is my wife.
I know the facts and circumstance of the case.

As such I am swearing this Shreedhar vs State By on 27 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57987456/
2 affidavit.
2.

sentences.text:
I state that, I filed the above Criminal Petition to quash the proceedings in Crime No.62/2024 dated 11/02/2024 pending against me and my family members (i.e.
Accused No.2 and 3 my father and mother), based on the complaint lodged by the Respondent No.2 (i.e. my wife) against me for the offences punishable under section 498A, 354, 307 R/w 34 of IPC and Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and the Accused No.3 (i.e. my mother) also had filed a criminal case against the 2nd Respondent in Crime No.48/2024 dated 03/02/2024 for the offence punishable under section 325 & 506 of IPC, both the NC: 2024:KHC:40486 aforesaid cases presently pending on the file of Hon'ble IX ACMM at Bengaluru.

3. I state that, my father and mother (i.e. Accused No.2 & 3 in Crime No.62/2024 dated 11/02/2024) have also filed an separate 482 Criminal Petition in Crl.Pet.No.3634/2024 to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.62/2024,
which is presently pending for consideration by this Hon'ble Court.
4.

I state that, presently myself and the 2nd Respondent and her family members together amicably settled the dispute between us with regard to the aforesaid 2 criminal cases which had been filed against each other and living together in my house in the above shown address with our children.

5. I state that, myself and 2nd Respondent and her family members amicably settled all the disputes and the 2nd Respondent is agreed to appear before this Hon'ble Court and to pray for quashing the Crime No.62/2024 dated 11/02/2024 pending on the file of Hon'ble IX ACMM at Bengaluru against me and my family members for the offences punishable under section 498A, 354, 307 R/w 34 of IPC and Sec. 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, based on the complaint lodged by 2nd Respondent.
6.
I state that, the compromise arrived between us is without any force, coercion or undue influence either from my side or from 2nd Respondent side.

WHEREFORE, I pray that the above Criminal Petition may be allowed and thereby quash the proceedings in Crime No.62/2024 against the Petitioner and others pending on the file of Hon'ble IX ACMM at Bengaluru in the ends of justice.
What is stated above are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and information and belief.

ORDER i.
The Criminal Petition is disposed.
